messages:
maria: FYI prod-gpu-12 OOM at 02:14 UTC after the kernel-selection rollout. Not a hard crash — metric shows slow memory erosion in kv cache leading to paging and then eviction storms.

devin: Can you paste the short alloc profile?

maria: quick dump from the node: ```
kv_cache: total_alloc=14.2G -> 17.8G over ~18m
page_faults spikes and pagewalk latency jumps
kernel backend: aten_v2_gpu_conv (switched from aten_v1 during canary)
batching: observed slightly larger batch sizes for short requests (auto-batcher heuristics tweak)
```

raj: interesting — kernel switch could change memory layout (larger per-token KV footprints). Also batching heuristics increasing average seq length per batch would amplify KV growth. any recent quant or dtype changes?

maria: no dtype changes, but the kernel selector started preferring the 'packed-attn' kernel for some sequences; that path allocs a contiguous KV slab instead of fragmented slabs. The slab size seems to grow with long dialogues instead of reusing pinned slots.

sara: ops-bot shows repeat soft-evict cycles on that host; reclaim didn't keep up and we hit OOM. We temporarily routed traffic off that host around 02:20.

devin: Repro plan: run 30m long-convo workload with canary kernel selection enabled, instrument kv-slot reuse and pagewalk lat. I can spin up a repro job.

maria: repro helps. In prod thread, we also saw one-off user flows where dialogs grew >12k tokens, which triggered prefix growth + sticky-slot accumulation.

raj: mitigation ideas: 1) tighten kv reuse window (aggressive LRU), 2) enable a soft-throttle on auto-batcher when avg seq > 2k, 3) add emergency fallback to a smaller model variant when host memory crosses threshold.

sara: +1 on emergency fallback. We have a routing flag to send to model:redispatch:safe-lite that points to the 7B variant. We can flip it for the affected deployment group.

maria: Quick patch I tested locally: ```json
{"kv.retention_ms": 60000, "kv.max_slots_per_shard": 1024, "runtime.eviction_threshold": 0.78}
```
that trimmed growth in 10m stress runs.

devin: Also propose a graceful degrade path in runtime: when pagewalks/sec > X and reclaim_rate < Y, switch kernel selector off the packed-attn path (force contiguous->fragmented fallback) and cap batch size to N. That avoids allocating large contiguous slabs mid-dialog.

raj: We should also emit a telemetry signal: kv.memory_erosion=true when slow steady growth observed (not instantaneous spike). That will let Optimize recommend different quant/kernels.

maria: For now I'm going to: 1) enable routing fallback (safe-lite) for the group, 2) deploy the retention patch as hot-config to the pool, 3) open a small perf rollback PR to revert the kernel selector change until we have a proper memory model.

ci-bot: deploy started for config hotpatch to pool-prod-group-7. Rollout 3/5 hosts.

ops-bot: routing flag safe-lite set for pool-prod-group-7 at 02:34 UTC.

devin: I'll start the repro run and add extended kv-slot sampling. tagging @raj for the kernel investigation.

maria: thanks — let's keep this thread for timeline and short notes. If anyone sees similar slow growth on other pools, ping here. :thumbsup:
